item.title: A total lunar eclipse is happening Tuesday, when the Earth turns the moon ‘blood’ red
item.description: It’s called the “Blood Moon” because of the red hue the earth’s atmosphere refracts onto the lunar surface as light from the sun passes through it. The post A total lunar eclipse is happening Tuesday, when the Earth turns the moon ‘blood’ red appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Toddler killed, 2 others seriously hurt when SUV backs over curb onto sidewalk
item.description: Police officers rushed the young girl to the hospital themselves to get her there as quickly as possible, but it was not enough to save her, authorities said. item.title: Long Beach cuts funding to free cart program for street vendors
item.description: City officials said it suffered from low participation. Vendors trying to get carts said they were frustrated by a sluggish application process. The post Long Beach cuts funding to free cart program for street vendors appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Cambodian Genocide survivor released from ICE custody after court order
item.description: Yi, who fled the genocide and came to the U.S. with her family in 1981, was detained by ICE at a routine immigration check-in in Santa Ana on Jan. 8 and held at the Adelanto Detention Facility for almost two months. The post Cambodian Genocide survivor released from ICE custody after court order appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.description: One Lakewood Station deputy was responding to a robbery call when he rear-ended a motorist, according to the lawsuit. The post LA County pays $4.9M to settle lawsuits stemming from Sheriff’s Department car crashes appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Long Beach’s streets are too dangerous, solutions too slow, City Council says
item.description: Plagued by long delays and a lack of answers, the City Council wants closer oversight of how the Public Works Department handles requests for new stop signs, left-turn signals, crosswalks and other safety measures. The post Long Beach’s streets are too dangerous, solutions too slow, City Council says appeared first on Long Beach Post.
